description: This is a helper class for managing production runs within the manufacturing module of Apache OFBiz. It provides methods to retrieve production run details, check for specific tasks, find linked production runs, and determine the root production run in a chain.

classes.name: ProductionRunHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to manage production run entities related to manufacturing processes in OFBiz.

methods.name: getProductionRun
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific production run, including related products and routing tasks, given a delegator and a production run ID.

methods.name: hasTask
methods.description: Checks if a specific task name exists within the work efforts associated with a given production effort ID.

methods.name: getLinkedProductionRuns
methods.description: Recursively gathers all production runs linked via precedent relationships starting from a given production run ID.

methods.name: getRootProductionRun
methods.description: Finds the topmost production run in a chain of linked production efforts based on precedence links.
